violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ricer and ice machines) were observed with an accumulation of food or biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized ricer and took ice machines out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The lactic acid concentration in the sanitizing solution of the storage room 3-bay sink was less than 452 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the lactic acid must be between 704-1875 ppm. Establishment will use other 3 bay sink in storage room. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

Egg yolk was observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC added ice to container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
Chemical bottle was observed stored on the same table with food in the store room. PIC removed chemical bottle. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution spray bottles in the store room was less than 100 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for quat sanitizer is between 200-400 ppm. PIC refilled and retested. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of dry ingredients in the store room. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine for all culinary labs. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025
Inspector observed a small accumulation of trash, litter and/or other debris in refuse area. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
Inspector observed cardboard receptacle outside overfilled. Establishment to increase removal. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The floors in the store room walk-in freezer and dry storage areas have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

The floors in the storage room seafood and meat walk-in coolers were in poor repair (holes and gaps in flooring). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2027

Molluscan Shellfish (clams) located in store room seafood walk-in cooler did not have the proper identification tags. Molluscan Shellstock tags must remain attached to the container in which the Molluscan Shellstock are received until the container is empty. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order AND THE DATE WHEN THE LAST SHELLFISH WAS USED from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025

Raw animal foods (such as eggs) were observed stored above various ready-to-eat foods in the store room and culinary labs 416 & 315. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated eggs. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris in culinary lab 416. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took slicer out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025

Thermometers are lacking in the lowboy refrigeration unit in culinary lab 416. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025

Chef was observed not wearing hair restraint in culinary lab 416. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025
Cleaned and sanitized equipment are not stored inverted in the storage room. PIC inverted equipment. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machines in all culinary labs. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025

The following non-food contact surfaces of have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - store room produce cooler 1 fan cover - store room food carts - store room food containers (old labels) New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025
Inspector observed an accumulation of trash/debris around trash compactor area. Area to be maintained clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025

The floors in the receiving dock walk-in freezer have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2025

Shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (meat grinder and pasta roller) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch.PIC moved to warewashing area to be wash and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

(ROP beef) was observed thawing in a pan stored in sink. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024
ROP Fish was observed thawing in sink with package still intact. Fish observed at 48DF. PIC voluntarily disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024
Food product were observed stored on the floor in the (receiving walk in and Alaska freezer ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the (slicer and ice machine vents ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024
Outside trash compacter area observed with debris, foliage, and litter. Outside refuse area must be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer Room 315) was observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/08/2023

The door to the outside, located in the loading dock, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023

Handwash sink located in the room 103 was observed leaking at the base of the faucet. The dish machine located in the room 315 was observed leaking at right top corner of machine. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/28/2023
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine air filter located by room 208 has an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/21/2023

The floors underneath the carbonzime machine located in room 315 has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/14/2023

The caulking in the ware washing area located in room 315 has an accumulation of black and pink residue. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/14/2023
